validation.deselection_reason: Five existing release/deploy tests need Windows symbolic-link privileges (WinError 1314).

policies.personal_installation: reference only; use an isolated copy for gameplay tests
policies.rest_trigger: completed rests only, once per party rest, after returning to a safe world state
policies.quick_cast_presentation: preserve visible engine casting animations and spell effects where verified
policies.duration_compensation: only effects produced by this run; existing effects age only by actual elapsed game time
policies.source_selection: prefer stronger eligible sources, using actual spell properties rather than raw character level; allow explicit source overrides
policies.recipient_priority: assign the preferred source to the first selected recipient, then reserve remaining sources for subsequent recipients
policies.availability: reserve underlying spell slots and physical item charge pools across the entire preset
policies.self_only: automatic assignments must preserve actual self-only restrictions
policies.party_buffs: one cast for an ordinary party-wide buff, retaining engine range and coverage rules
